action: Save an attempt with actual evidence; submit success only after the stated outcome occurred.
description: Save your own HTML/CSS page containing the fragment, responsive layout, and visible focus. In a local browser record version, keyboard path, narrow/wide/zoom observations, one repair and retest.
failureFeedback: Keep the diagnostic and label the attempt failed or blocked. Repair the cause and rerun before reporting success.
hint: Use a fresh learner-owned directory and the documented platform/tool recipe.
prompt: Save your own HTML/CSS page containing the fragment, responsive layout, and visible focus. In a local browser record version, keyboard path, narrow/wide/zoom observations, one repair and retest.
successConditions: Page actually opens; reported keyboard and layout checks pass after repair; include source or artifact reference. Missing or failed checks remain pending.
verificationLimit: Server can validate fields and the explicit success status; it does not execute tools, grade arbitrary prose, or independently verify the reported outcome.
